summary: End-to-end backend + frontend test of Fatture Elettroniche XML app. All 28 backend pytest tests pass (auth incl. brute-force lockout, settings VAT IT-prefix normalization, bulk upload XML/.p7m/.zip, duplicate detection, non-xml rejection, invoice list with natural sort 9/10/100, search, year filter, detail, XML download, CSV export semicolon/BOM, anagrafiche, stats, delete). Frontend UI smoke test confirms login/logout, protected nav, settings save (sidebar shows P.IVA 01234567890), bulk upload of 4 files -> 5 ok + 1 duplicate (lotto.zip contains dup p7m), year tabs 2025, natural sort rendering 9->10->100, search filter, invoice detail with toggle-xml/download-xml/delete buttons, raw XML pre visible, Anagrafiche clienti/fornitori tabs (1 each), CSV export button present. No critical issues found.

issues: Recharts emits width(-1)/height(-1) console warning on initial render when stats are empty - cosmetic only, chart renders once data arrives

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 96/97: set_cookie uses secure=True + samesite='none' which is correct for cross-site HTTPS preview, but will NOT work on plain http://localhost:3000 dev. Document this or branch by env.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager for FastAPI >=0.95.
upload_invoices processes files sequentially inside a single request; for large bulk (100s of files) consider streaming/async batching to avoid request timeouts.
No endpoint to delete an anagrafica (orphaned when all its invoices are deleted). Consider auto-cleanup or admin DELETE /api/anagrafiche/{id}.
No pagination on /api/anagrafiche (hard cap 2000) - fine for MVP, flag for scale.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed. Test data (invoices, anagrafiche, settings, login_attempts) created during testing was cleaned up at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (28 tests, all pass). Run with: python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -o 'addopts=' (project pytest.ini enables xdist which causes race on shared login_attempts & invoice listing - disable addopts for stable results). Samples at /app/tests/samples (xml, .xml.p7m, lotto.zip). Admin credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Clean DB after tests: invoices/anagrafiche/settings/login_attempts collections.
